entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to get a return processed for over a week! I want to return this useless VeloBand and your website is a complete joke.
I certainly understand your frustration, and I'm sorry to hear you've had a bad experience. To make sure I can help you properly, is it a technical fault with the band or a matter of preference?
It doesn't matter! What matters is that I tried to return it well within your window, and your entire system was down! I demand a refund now, or I'm speaking to a manager.
I see. Let's get this sorted out for you. I can see you received the band 20 days ago. Can you tell me when you attempted the return online?

I tried on day NINE. I went to the returns page, filled everything out, and then I got a major website error when I tried to submit it. I couldn't print the label or anything. It was a total waste of my time. I even took a screenshot!

Thank you for providing those details. I'm checking our system status reports for that period right now. ... Yes, I can confirm that our return portal system was down for maintenance that day, which caused issues for several customers. I sincerely apologize for that.
See? I told you! So you're going to fix this, right? Are you going to process my refund or am I going to have to file a complaint and light up your company on every review site I can find?

There's absolutely no need for that, I can take care of this for you right now. I'm just pulling up your account and our return policy. ... Okay, I see here that you received the item 20 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Well, it's about time something went right. So what's next?

I have just overridden the system and approved a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Fine. Just make sure the email actually arrives this time.
It has just been sent. You should have it within a few minutes. Again, my apologies for the website issue you encountered. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
